fixes.explanation: Shepherd? Baker, I've seen a lot of sheep in my day, and not one of them was in this verse. The Levite says Micah has hired him to be his priest, right after the "…this and that…" part. I think that "this and that" is doing a lot of heavy lifting. The spies' very next request is for him to inquire of God, so they heard "priest" loud and clear.

An ephod, household gods, a graven image, and a molten idol, all in ONE house! The spies ask, "Did you know that one of these houses has…" and then they read off the whole list like a grocery receipt. That's a lot to have under one roof, friend. Then they add, "Now think about what you should do," and they leave it hanging there. I'd say that's a hint with no hiding in it.

Bethel? Ohhh, nice try, baker, but that name isn't in this verse. The text says they named it Dan, after their forefather Dan, who was born to Israel. The city had formerly been named Laish. So the new name came straight off the family tree, no guessing needed.
